Name: Phantasmal Shroud
Description:
You create a mantle of energy that forms around you, pouring from your body and empowering your actions. Until the spell ends, any attack you make deals 1d8 extra damage when you hit a creature within 10 feet of you. This damage is radiant, necrotic, or cold (your choice when you cast the spell). Any creature that takes this damage can’t regain hit points until the start of your next turn.

In addition, any creature of your choice that you can see that starts its turn within 10 feet of you has its speed reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.
At Higher Levels:
When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, you can choose one of the following effects for each slot level above 3rd:

• The range for the spell’s extra damage and for selecting targets to decrease their speed is doubled.
• Creatures whose speed is reduced by this effect have it reduced by an additional 5 feet.
• (2 slot levels) The damage increases by 1d8.
Sourcebook: Lyres Guide to Retia - Land of Industry
